text:
ola chen: Hi team — Ola here, joining Platform Reliability (IC2) today! Quick day-one asks so I don't block anyone:
- MDM: I got an M2 Mac. Should I enroll now or wait for the device image from IT?
- Peripherals: need a compact keyboard and a second monitor (I work UTC+8 evenings). Who handles that?
- Access: please add me to the 'platform-reliability' org in Console (read) and give me a small dev quota on the staging cluster.
- Fun fact: I collect vintage cassette tapes and still have a Walkman. :cassette:

mira (people ops): Welcome Ola!! :tada:
- Enroll at https://mdm.redwood.example/enroll and select "Company Mac - Apple Silicon" for M2. IT typically pushes provisioning within ~30m after enrollment.
- Peripherals: fill https://forms.redwood.example/equipment and choose "peripheral pack (monitor + keyboard)"; add "evening shift" in notes. We'll prioritize based on stock.
- Console/cluster: confirm the org slug (looks like "platform-reliability"). I'll open IAM + quota tickets and assign a buddy. DM me your shipping address for stickers.

ben (devex): Hey Ola  I'm your buddy for week one. Quick checklist to speed things up:
- Add SSH key -> https://id.redwood.example/account/ssh-keys
- Test jump host access:
```
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 ola@jump.redwood.com
```
- VPN: use 'redwood-wireguard' profile. If you hit cert errors paste them here and I'll help. Happy to screenshare this afternoon (UTC+8 friendly).

riley (eng): Added you to #eng and drafted you into the oncall rotation. You'll get a PagerDuty DM after provisioning. For staging quota, put "platform-reliability, small (dev)" on the form and tag me for fast approval.

mdm-bot: Enrollment received for ola.chen@example.com. Device: MacBookPro (arm64). Provisioning status: pending (approx 25m).

ola chen: Thanks all  enrolled and submitted the equipment form. Mira  DMing address now. Ben  screenshare in ~90 mins works for me. Also re: cassette tapes  will try to dig up a pic later for #random. :thumbsup:
